title: Year 4 grammar and spelling check (adverbials, homophones, speech punctuation; teacher-made, 20 questions)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 49 (Year 4 grammar and spelling check (adverbials, homophones, speech punctuation; teacher-made, 20 questions))
intro: Lesson 49: Grammar and spelling check: adverbials, homophones and speech punctuation. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Punctuate: is it far asked Tam

parts.text: Inverted commas around the spoken words
Capital letter to start the speech
Question mark inside the closing inverted commas

keywords.def: when, where or how words at the start, then a comma
words that sound the same but are spelt differently
a next step to work on

questions.q: Fix: across the valley a yak grazed
questions.a: Across the valley, a yak grazed.

questions.q: Choose: I cannot decide (weather/whether) to go.
Punctuate: we made it said Sam
Core: complete the 20-question grammar and spelling check on your own (portal quiz)
Extend: mark your answers with the teacher and correct mistakes in green
Stretch: write your target for next half term
questions.a: For example: I will check commas after fronted adverbials.
A) "Wait for me," called Mia.. A has the comma inside the inverted commas and the reporting clause outside.
A) the same sound, different spelling
